actions.name: ContinueServiceDeployment
actions.description: Grants permission to continue a paused service deployment

actions.name: CreateCapacityProvider
actions.description: Grants permission to create a new capacity provider. Capacity providers are associated with an Amazon ECS cluster and are used in capacity provider strategies to facilitate cluster auto scaling

actions.name: CreateCluster
actions.description: Grants permission to create a new Amazon ECS cluster

actions.name: CreateDaemon
actions.description: Grants permission to create a new daemon in a specified cluster

actions.name: CreateExpressGatewayService
actions.description: Grants permission to create a new Amazon ECS Express Gateway service with cluster and task definition

actions.name: CreateService
actions.description: Grants permission to run and maintain a desired number of tasks from a specified task definition via service creation

actions.name: CreateTaskSet
actions.description: Grants permission to create a new Amazon ECS task set

actions.name: DeleteAccountSetting
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the ARN and resource ID format of a resource for a specified IAM user, IAM role, or the root user for an account. You can specify whether the new ARN and resource ID format are disabled for new resources that are created

actions.name: DeleteAttributes
actions.description: Grants permission to delete one or more custom attributes from an Amazon ECS resource

actions.name: DeleteCapacityProvider
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified capacity provider

actions.name: DeleteCluster
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified cluster

actions.name: DeleteDaemon
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a specified daemon within a cluster

actions.name: DeleteDaemonTaskDefinition
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified daemon task definition

actions.name: DeleteExpressGatewayService
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a specified Express Gateway service

actions.name: DeleteService
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a specified service within a cluster

actions.name: DeleteTaskDefinitions
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified task definitions by family and revision

actions.name: DeleteTaskSet
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified task set

actions.name: DeregisterContainerInstance
actions.description: Grants permission to deregister an Amazon ECS container instance from the specified cluster

actions.name: DeregisterTaskDefinition
actions.description: Grants permission to deregister the specified task definition by family and revision

actions.name: DescribeCapacityProviders
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more Amazon ECS capacity providers

actions.name: DescribeClusters
actions.description: Grants permission to describes one or more of your clusters

actions.name: DescribeContainerInstances
actions.description: Grants permission to describes Amazon ECS container instances

actions.name: DescribeDaemon
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the specified daemon running in your cluster

actions.name: DescribeDaemonDeployments
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more of your daemon deployments

actions.name: DescribeDaemonRevisions
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more of your daemon revisions

actions.name: DescribeDaemonTaskDefinition
actions.description: Grants permission to describe a daemon task definition

actions.name: DescribeExpressGatewayService
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the specified Express Gateway service

actions.name: DescribeServiceDeployments
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more of your service deployments

actions.name: DescribeServiceRevisions
actions.description: Grants permission to describe one or more of your service revisions

actions.name: DescribeServices
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the specified services running in your cluster

actions.name: DescribeTaskDefinition
actions.description: Grants permission to describe a task definition. You can specify a family and revision to find information about a specific task definition, or you can simply specify the family to find the latest ACTIVE revision in that family

actions.name: DescribeTaskSets
actions.description: Grants permission to describe Amazon ECS task sets

actions.name: DescribeTasks
actions.description: Grants permission to describe a specified task or tasks

actions.name: DiscoverPollEndpoint
actions.description: Grants permission to get an endpoint for the Amazon ECS agent to poll for updates

actions.name: ExecuteCommand
actions.description: Grants permission to run a command remotely on an Amazon ECS container

actions.name: GetTaskProtection
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the protection status of tasks in an Amazon ECS service

actions.name: ListAccountSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to list the account settings for an Amazon ECS resource for a specified principal

actions.name: ListAttributes
actions.description: Grants permission to lists the attributes for Amazon ECS resources within a specified target type and cluster

actions.name: ListClusters
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of existing clusters

actions.name: ListContainerInstances
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of container instances in a specified cluster

actions.name: ListDaemonDeployments
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of daemon deployments for a specified daemon

actions.name: ListDaemonTaskDefinitions
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of daemon task definitions that are registered to your account

actions.name: ListDaemons
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of daemons that are running in a specified cluster

actions.name: ListServiceDeployments
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of service deployments for a specified service

actions.name: ListServices
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of services that are running in a specified cluster

actions.name: ListServicesByNamespace
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of services that are running in a specified AWS Cloud Map Namespace

actions.name: ListTagsForResource
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of tags for the specified resource

actions.name: ListTaskDefinitionFamilies
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of task definition families that are registered to your account (which may include task definition families that no longer have any ACTIVE task definitions)

actions.name: ListTaskDefinitions
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of task definitions that are registered to your account

actions.name: ListTasks
actions.description: Grants permission to get a list of tasks for a specified cluster

actions.name: PutAccountSetting
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the ARN and resource ID format of a resource for a specified IAM user, IAM role, or the root user for an account. You can specify whether the new ARN and resource ID format are enabled for new resources that are created. Enabling this setting is required to use new Amazon ECS features such as resource tagging

actions.name: PutAccountSettingDefault
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the ARN and resource ID format of a resource type for all IAM users on an account for which no individual account setting has been set. Enabling this setting is required to use new Amazon ECS features such as resource tagging

actions.name: PutAttributes
actions.description: Grants permission to create or update an attribute on an Amazon ECS resource

actions.name: PutClusterCapacityProviders
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the available capacity providers and the default capacity provider strategy for a cluster

actions.name: RegisterContainerInstance
actions.description: Grants permission to register an EC2 instance into the specified cluster

actions.name: RegisterDaemonTaskDefinition
actions.description: Grants permission to register a new daemon task definition from the supplied family and containerDefinitions

actions.name: RegisterTaskDefinition
actions.description: Grants permission to register a new task definition from the supplied family and containerDefinitions

actions.name: RunTask
actions.description: Grants permission to start a task using random placement and the default Amazon ECS scheduler

actions.name: StartTask
actions.description: Grants permission to start a new task from the specified task definition on the specified container instance or instances

actions.name: StopServiceDeployment
actions.description: Grants permission to stop an ongoing service deployment

actions.name: StopTask
actions.description: Grants permission to stop a running task

actions.name: SubmitAttachmentStateChanges
actions.description: Grants permission to send an acknowledgement that attachments changed states

actions.name: SubmitContainerStateChange
actions.description: Grants permission to send an acknowledgement that a container changed states

actions.name: SubmitTaskStateChange
actions.description: Grants permission to send an acknowledgement that a task changed states

actions.name: TagResource
actions.description: Grants permission to tag the specified resource

actions.name: UntagResource
actions.description: Grants permission to untag the specified resource

actions.name: UpdateCapacityProvider
actions.description: Grants permission to update the specified capacity provider

actions.name: UpdateCluster
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the configuration or settings to use for a cluster

actions.name: UpdateClusterSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the settings to use for a cluster

actions.name: UpdateContainerAgent
actions.description: Grants permission to update the Amazon ECS container agent on a specified container instance

actions.name: UpdateContainerInstancesState
actions.description: Grants permission to the user to modify the status of an Amazon ECS container instance

actions.name: UpdateDaemon
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the parameters of a daemon

actions.name: UpdateExpressGatewayService
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the parameters of an Express Gateway service

actions.name: UpdateService
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the parameters of a service

actions.name: UpdateServicePrimaryTaskSet
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the primary task set used in a service

actions.name: UpdateTaskProtection
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the protection status of a task

actions.name: UpdateTaskSet
actions.description: Grants permission to update the specified task set

actions.name: AllowVendedLogDeliveryForResource
actions.description: Grants permission to allow vended log delivery for a specified resource

actions.name: Poll
actions.description: Grants permission to an agent to connect with the Amazon ECS service to report status and get commands

actions.name: PutSystemLogEvents
actions.description: Grants permission to collect system logs from the container instances

actions.name: StartTelemetrySession
actions.description: Grants permission to start a telemetry session
